name: cli-status-row-heartbeat
description: M21 S6: one inbound, three Claude turns (tool_use, tool_use, final text) with the harness test clock advanced 61s then 90s as the scripted LLM calls are served. Pins the bare-channel Task HUD status-row legs deterministically: the 60s first-fire ('61s in ... I'll keep going.') and the 150s softening ('151s in ... taking longer than usual') — previously unfixturable without a real 60s wall-clock wait (the M18 X2 known gap).
